why: Found by I116 while writing its prereg, before any build commit or measured run (Q67: a test is never dropped from its CI job; amended to name the mode it was written for). P1 says the protocols before I112 name no run_routing, disch.section_errors or preflight, so I112's opt-ins reach no earlier key's record. It globbed every spec/M[4-6]/lib/i*_run.json except i112_run.json, so it also judged later keys: I116's protocol (spec/M6/lib/i116_run.json, I112's plus document_fallback) carries I112's opt-ins by construction and would fail it, although no earlier protocol changed. The amended check also skips the protocols of I112 and later keys (an iteration field I112 or above), as I112 amended I111's test_p6. Every earlier protocol is still checked, and the claim is unchanged.
